## Enterprise solar proposal software pricing

**Solargraf publishes a $12,999/year Enterprise plan; Aurora and HelioScope require custom quotes.** Here’s the current comparison, checked September 28, 2026. Prices below are USD.

| Software | Enterprise pricing | Key inclusions / considerations |
|---|---|---|
| **Solargraf** | **$12,999/year**—approximately $1,083/month equivalent | Includes **1,500 projects/year, unlimited users and public API access**. Additional projects cost **$9 each**. Includes proposals, design, financing and CRM. [Official pricing](https://www.solargraf.com/pricing) |
| **Aurora Solar** | **Custom per-project pricing** | Unlimited users, APIs/integrations, advanced permissions, dealer configurations and AI-assisted site models. Volume discounts on credits; minimum commitment requires a sales quote. Premium support, training and certain services are add-ons. [Official pricing](https://aurorasolar.com/pricing/) |
| **HelioScope** | **Custom per-project pricing** | Commercial solar-plus-storage design and proposals, unlimited users, direct API access, SSO and designs up to 30 MW DC. For comparison, non-enterprise **Pro costs $2,640/user/year**, including 120 projects. [Official pricing](https://helioscope.aurorasolar.com/pricing/) |
| **OpenSolar** | **Free core platform; custom-priced Enterprise services** | Optional **Support: $500/month**; **Customize: $1,350/month**, including support and bespoke proposal content. Enterprise services are tailored to requirements. [Official pricing](https://www.opensolar.com/enterprise-services/) |

**Important OpenSolar caveat:** API access is a paid, per-project add-on with region-specific pricing; connectors have separate monthly pricing. Don’t assume a free platform means free integrations. [API pricing details](https://www.opensolar.com/api/)

### Budgeting guidance
- **Published-price benchmark:** At 3,000 projects/year, Solargraf’s listed Enterprise pricing calculates to **$26,499/year**, before other charges.
- **Compare total annual cost**, including project overages, onboarding, API/CRM integration, premium imagery, e-signatures and support.
- Ask vendors what counts as a billable **project**—not necessarily a proposal, revision or completed installation.

**Which country, how many users and annual projects, and residential or commercial?** Those details would let me narrow this to a realistic budget and shortlist.
